meaning:
δολιόω
(δόλιος), [in LXX: Num.25:18, Psa.105:25 (נָכַל), Psa.5:6 (חָלַק hi.) * ;]
to deceive: ἐδολιοῦσαν (-σαν, frequently in κοινή Gk. for imperfect 3rd of person(s) pl.), Rom.3:13 (LXX).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: “Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”
